scientific_integrity: The classical quadratic Gauss-sum evaluation is cited, not claimed as new. All infinite statements have algebraic proofs; finite checks are corroborative. Specialist bibliographic priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns four consecutive characters and sampling on nonzero quadratic residues for primes congruent to one modulo four; p=5 has rank two. No result for arbitrary four-column sets, the augmented Paley matrix, other prime classes or general RIP is claimed.
title: A four-class Paley sampling law for four consecutive Fourier characters
